story: At 5:17 on this partly cloudy Tuesday in Sumter Oaks, Gary and Donna are stepping onto pickleball court one to start slow kitchen-line drills, while Donna is delighted to have just accepted Rosa's Friday dinner invitation and promised a bottle of something nice. Rosa, still at the Rec Center, is cheerfully marinating pork and asking Gary to bring a folding chair. Meanwhile Hal, watchful as ever, is checking the bulletin board on Magnolia Loop for architectural review notices and the filing deadline.
events: Gary (pickleball court 1): Step onto court one with Donna and start slow kitchen-line drills
Hal (street bulletin board): Check for architectural review notices and the filing deadline

gary.thought_process: Donna's ready to hit the court and I already told Rosa I'm in for Friday with flan, so nothing more to say there. My knees do better warmed up slow, and Donna's looking out for me. The court's right here, so I'll head to court one and start easy with the kitchen line basics like she said. I'm not talking again, just getting on with it. The cart build can wait until after practice.

parameters.content: Step onto court one with Donna and start slow kitchen-line drills

donna.thought_process: Rosa just invited me to Friday pork dinner at six with Hal and Gary. Gary already confirmed to her about flan and I confirmed to Gary I wouldn't miss it, but Rosa hasn't heard my yes directly. Answer her warmly now, then I can get Gary onto court one. Don't re-ask Gary anything; just close the loop with Rosa.

parameters.content: Rosa, yes, a hundred times yes! Friday at six, and I'll bring a bottle of something nice for the table. Gary and I are about to hit court one, so save us a seat and a plate.

hal.thought_process: I'm at Magnolia Loop with nobody around, and my last action was counting Donna's flamingos. I mean to report them and Gary's cart, but both are settled for Friday dinner and I'd rather not walk into dinner having filed a complaint. The count is already done, so the next step is to check the street bulletin board for any posted notices on the architectural review, Tuesday's meeting, or cart paperwork. That gives me what I need to decide without being hasty.

parameters.content: Check for architectural review notices and the filing deadline

rosa.thought_process: All three neighbors have said yes to Friday at six: Hal gave his word, Gary is bringing flan and offered chairs or an extension cord, and Donna just said she wouldn't miss it. I've already invited everyone, so asking again would be silly. Gary asked me a direct question, though, and a good host answers. I don't need much, but folding chairs would help since my table only seats four comfortably. Answer him briefly, then leave them to their pickleball and go start prepping the pork.

parameters.content: Flan's plenty, Gary, just bring yourself. If you've got a spare folding chair, I'll take it, my table's a squeeze with four. Now go enjoy your lesson, I've got pork to marinate.

laws.title: Cart Modifications
laws.text: Exterior golf cart modifications visible from the street require Architectural Review approval.

laws.title: Lawn Ornaments
laws.text: No more than 3 decorative ornaments may be visible from the street.

laws.title: Quiet Hours
laws.text: No amplified sound from 10 PM to 7 AM.

laws.title: Holiday Decor
laws.text: Holiday lighting is permitted from Thanksgiving through January 15.

laws.title: Court Reservations
laws.text: Pickleball courts may be reserved for a maximum of 2 hours per party.

laws.title: Parking
laws.text: No parking on the grass. Carts and cars stay on driveways or the street.
